item.title: Henry Cavill’s Warhammer 40K Series Just Got a Cryptic Update From Mike Flanagan
item.description: You probably know Mike Flanagan as one of the modern masters of cinematic horror. He's the person behind Midnight Mass , The Haunting of Hill House , the latest Carrie adaptation, and he even wrote the script for DC's Clayface . When he isn't thinking about the next Stephen King story he can bring to the screen, Flanagan is hard at work on an entirely different project: Warhammer 40K .

item.title: Limited-Time Pokémon Cards Accidentally Revealed a Year Early
item.description: Last week, McDonald's and The Pokémon Company confirmed that Pokémon and McDonald's would be coming together yet again for a new promotional event in November. In the reveal post, The Pokémon Company showed the Pokémon trading cards and toys that would be given out with each Happy Meal. However, pictures of the wrong set of cards were accidentally posted, apparently revealing the promotional assets for next year's collaboration.

item.title: Target Officially Launches New Pokémon System and It's a Total Game Changer
item.description: Target is one of the best ways to purchase Pokémon cards — and also one of the worst. The retailer typically releases new products on weekdays after midnight, pushing devoted trading card game fans to stay awake for hours for a chance to spend money. More often than not, the fans who make this sacrifice lose out badly to bots that can snap everything up within milliseconds. Well, that's all about to change.

item.title: 14:49 Locked Doors and Cyphers with Professional DM, Deborah Ann Woll | Shelf Quest
item.description: Deborah Ann Woll is a storyteller through and through. She takes us through the gaming mechanics that she brings into her DMing, teaches us how to solve cyphers, talks storytelling obstacles for RPGs and marvels at the huge advances gaming has made in the last 20 years. Plus, the unlikely inspiration behind her God of War and The Cycle roles!

item.title: Deadpool Star Ryan Reynolds Rumored to Be Working on New Marvel Movie
item.description: Ryan Reynolds’ involvement with the MCU might not be over just yet. According to a leak from CartierFilms , Reynolds is writing a Marvel project centered on the Canadian superhero group Alpha Flight. It’s unclear whether the group will get its own dedicated movie or be featured prominently in the next Deadpool film. Earlier this year , Reynolds teased that he will return to the MCU as the merc with a mouth. CartierFilms also claimed that a new actor is in talks to take the reins as Wolverine, and could debut in the Alpha Flight project.

item.title: Anthropic Is Officially Stepping In to Stop Claude from Cloning Games
item.description: AI games have taken over digital storefronts this year. Steam Next Fest, a demo showcase event, was a disaster, as AI games flooded the platform, making it harder for fans to filter the results and find hidden indie gems. According to itch.io, the number of game pages being created has doubled in the past two months, likely related to the popularity of "vibe coding " and AI tools such as Claude. It's not just "original" AI games that are a big concern; AI-generated remakes and copycats have become a growing issue in the gaming industry.

item.title: Brandon Sanderson Officially Teases Speedy Release of Remaining Stormlight Archive Books
item.description: It's only been two years since Brandon Sanderson released Wind and Truth , wrapping up the first half of The Stormlight Archive . While the author is plenty busy with several more books and multiple live-action adaptations of his work, Sanderson is already thinking about getting started on the second half of the beloved series. Talking on a Halloween stream (in a pretty great Shrek costume), the fantasy author revealed he's already got a loose release schedule for the next five Stormlight Archive books.

item.title: The Batman Part 2's Mystery Villains May Have Just Been Confirmed in Major Leak
item.description: Several newcomers were confirmed for The Batman Part 2 's cast over the summer, including Sebastian Stan, Scarlett Johansson, Brian Tyree Henry, and Charles Dance. Their roles in the DC film haven't been confirmed yet, though that hasn't stopped the speculation. Rumors pointed to Stan playing the serial killer Victor Zsasz while Stan himself seemingly confirmed he'd be playing Harvey Dent in an interview with the French outlet Le Journal du Dimanche . (That article has since been updated, and the mention of Harvey Dent removed from it.) Now, it seems like Heidi Klum's Halloween costume team has confirmed Stan and Henry's roles in The Batman Part 2 .

item.title: Star Wars Zero Company’s Cast Talks About That Huge Order 66 Moment
item.description: Order 66 and the Great Jedi Purge have been depicted in various Star Wars media, like Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order and Star Wars: The Bad Batch . Bit Reactor’s beloved strategy game Star Wars Zero Company has its own huge Order 66 moment.
